executive_summary: KPI-0's rework_rate conflated a worker running handoff.js execute before phase sub-agent evidence exists with a genuine gate failure -- 57.9% of a measured 7-day rejected-handoff cohort was this premature-attempt class, with no owner. This SD splits the reader's numerator into premature_attempts vs gate_retries, and adds a PreToolUse enforcement block (ENF-18) that refuses the premature call before it ever writes a rejected row, reusing the existing sub-agent evidence gate rather than a second predicate. A LEAD-phase VALIDATION review caught and fixed a follow-on defect: the refusal check originally used the raw CLI-typed SD identifier instead of the resolved database row, which silently refused nearly every real handoff call.

functional_requirements.title: Split the KPI-0 rejected-handoff numerator
functional_requirements.description: lib/oversight/coordinator-health-sharpenings.mjs's deriveOutcomeFlow classifies each rejected/failed cohort handoff by validation_details.summary.failed_gate: SUBAGENT_EVIDENCE_MISSING or PREREQUISITE_PREFLIGHT_FAILED count as premature_attempts, everything else counts as gate_retries.
acceptance_criteria: A cohort with 2 premature-tagged and 1 real-gate-tagged rejected handoff reports premature_attempts=2, gate_retries=1
A rejected handoff with no validation_details (legacy row) counts as a gate retry, never premature
Empty cohort reports premature_attempts/premature_attempt_rate/gate_retries as null, never a fake 0

functional_requirements.title: rework_rate counts only genuine gate failures
functional_requirements.description: rework_rate is redefined to gate_retries / cohortHandoffs.length, no longer including premature attempts. PREMATURE_ATTEMPT_CEILING added alongside the existing REWORK_CEILING as a named, reviewable threshold (observability only, not wired into an alarm by this SD).
acceptance_criteria: rework_rate on the split-cohort test case equals 1/4, not 3/4
PREMATURE_ATTEMPT_CEILING is exported as a named numeric constant in (0, 1]

functional_requirements.title: ENF-18 refuses a premature handoff.js execute call
functional_requirements.description: scripts/hooks/pre-tool-enforce.cjs's ENF-18 block matches a Bash command against `handoff.js execute TYPE SD-ID` and, when validateSubagentEvidence (scripts/modules/handoff/gates/subagent-evidence-gate.js) reports the phase's required sub-agent evidence absent, refuses the call (exit 2) before the ~10s preflight write that would otherwise land a rejected sd_phase_handoffs row.
acceptance_criteria: A handoff.js execute call for a phase with no fresh required-agent evidence exits 2 with an [ENF-18] message naming the missing agent(s)
A handoff.js precheck call (dry-run) is never matched or refused
The refusal audit row records failed_gate=SUBAGENT_EVIDENCE_MISSING, matching the literal FR-1's premature_attempts classification reads

functional_requirements.title: WAIT verdicts are never refused
functional_requirements.description: When validateSubagentEvidence returns a WAIT verdict (evidence row created within the race window, still landing), ENF-18 must allow the call through rather than refusing it, mirroring prerequisite-preflight.js's own WAIT handling.
acceptance_criteria: evaluateHandoffExecutePrecheck returns {refuse:false} when validateSubagentEvidence returns {passed:false, wait:true}

functional_requirements.title: Resolve the SD identifier before calling validateSubagentEvidence
functional_requirements.description: The CLI-typed SD identifier (often the sd_key) is resolved to its canonical strategic_directives_v2 row via resolveSdInputOrNull (scripts/lib/sd-id-resolver.js) before being passed to validateSubagentEvidence, mirroring prerequisite-preflight.js's lookupSdIdForFk. Passing the raw token directly silently matched zero sub_agent_execution_results rows and refused essentially every real execute call (measured live, VALIDATION sub-agent finding).
acceptance_criteria: evaluateHandoffExecutePrecheck calls validateSubagentEvidence with the RESOLVED sd row and sd.id, not the raw rawSdId argument
Live A/B verification against SD-LEO-FIX-KPI-COUNTS-CHEAP-001 itself: the SD-key form and the resolved-UUID form report the identical, correct missing-agent list after the fix

functional_requirements.title: Fail open on infra failures and unresolvable identifiers
functional_requirements.description: ENF-18 must never refuse a call solely because the SD identifier could not be resolved, or because validateSubagentEvidence returned an infra-failure shape (details.reason of MISSING_CONTEXT or DB_ERROR, which carries no `wait` field). The real downstream gate still enforces the check later.
acceptance_criteria: evaluateHandoffExecutePrecheck returns {refuse:false} and never calls validateSubagentEvidence when resolveSdInputOrNull returns {sd:null}
evaluateHandoffExecutePrecheck returns {refuse:false} when details.reason is MISSING_CONTEXT or DB_ERROR

technical_requirements.title: Single representation of the evidence predicate
technical_requirements.description: ENF-18 reuses the SAME validateSubagentEvidence function the real GATE_SUBAGENT_EVIDENCE gate and the execute-time prerequisite preflight already call. No second copy of the evidence predicate is introduced (QF-20260807-283).

technical_requirements.title: Testable decision logic, no live hook import in tests
technical_requirements.description: parseHandoffExecuteCall and evaluateHandoffExecutePrecheck live in scripts/hooks/lib/handoff-execute-precheck-guard.cjs, a module with no top-level side effects. pre-tool-enforce.cjs itself cannot be required directly from a test runner without blocking, because its module-load-time `fs.readFileSync(0)` stdin read never reaches EOF under vitest.

technical_requirements.title: Escape hatch
technical_requirements.description: LEO_HANDOFF_EXECUTE_PRECHECK_GUARD=off skips ENF-18 entirely, for the rare case evidence is genuinely satisfied by a means this check cannot see.

technical_requirements.title: No schema or migration changes
technical_requirements.description: This SD is read-only against the database (sd_phase_handoffs, sub_agent_execution_results, strategic_directives_v2) and writes only to permission_audit_log via the existing auditPermissionDecision helper on refusal. No new table, column, or migration.

Legacy rejected handoff row with no validation_details
test_scenarios.expected: Counted as a gate retry, never premature
premature_attempts, premature_attempt_rate, gate_retries all null (never a fake 0)
refuse:true, missing list populated, validateSubagentEvidence called with the RESOLVED sd and sd.id

test_scenarios.scenario: evaluateHandoffExecutePrecheck with MISSING_CONTEXT/DB_ERROR or an unresolvable SD identifier
test_scenarios.expected: refuse:false in all cases; validateSubagentEvidence never called when the identifier cannot be resolved

test_scenarios.scenario: Live subprocess smoke test of the hook against this SD's own LEAD-TO-PLAN handoff
test_scenarios.expected: Before the identifier fix: reports missing VALIDATION+Explore despite fresh VALIDATION evidence. After the fix: reports only the genuinely missing Explore evidence

acceptance_criteria: All 47+ unit tests across tests/unit/oversight/coordinator-health-sharpenings.test.js and scripts/hooks/__tests__/pre-tool-enforce-enf18-handoff-precheck.test.js pass
Zero regressions in the existing pre-tool-enforce.cjs and coordinator-health-sharpenings.mjs test suites
Live subprocess verification of ENF-18 against a real SD confirms correct refuse/allow behavior before and after the identifier-resolution fix
LEO_HANDOFF_EXECUTE_PRECHECK_GUARD=off is confirmed by code inspection to skip ENF-18 entirely

risks.risk: A bug in ENF-18 could wrongly block ALL handoff.js execute calls fleet-wide (false positive)
risks.mitigation: Reuses the already-proven validateSubagentEvidence predicate; fails open on any internal error, missing DB creds, unresolvable identifier, or infra-failure shape; off-switch env var; live A/B smoke-tested against a real SD

risks.risk: A bug could silently no-op the refusal (false negative), leaving KPI-0 unimproved
risks.mitigation: The real preflight still enforces the same check downstream -- a missed refusal degrades to pre-fix behavior, not a new failure mode

risks.risk: rework_rate's redefinition could read as a metric regression on a dashboard that doesn't know about the split
risks.mitigation: premature_attempts/gate_retries returned on the same object alongside rework_rate so both numbers stay visible; no dashboard code found (Explore discovery) that hardcodes a rework_rate% narrative

consumers: Every worker session's Bash PreToolUse pipeline (scripts/hooks/pre-tool-enforce.cjs runs on every Bash tool call)
scripts/adam-coordinator-health.mjs (reads computeOutcomeFlow's output for the fleet health dashboard)
data_contracts: Write: permission_audit_log via the existing auditPermissionDecision helper on a refusal (no new column)
observability_rollout: premature_attempts / premature_attempt_rate / gate_retries fields on computeOutcomeFlow's returned object, alongside the existing rework_rate
ENF-18 refusals logged to stderr with an [ENF-18] prefix and recorded via auditPermissionDecision(ruleCode='ENF-18')

system_architecture.summary: A PreToolUse enforcement hook refuses a premature handoff.js execute Bash call by reusing the existing sub-agent evidence gate before the call's own preflight would write a rejected row; a companion reader-side change stops that same class of row from inflating the KPI-0 rework metric.

components.change: deriveOutcomeFlow splits rejected-handoff numerator into premature_attempts/gate_retries; new PREMATURE_ATTEMPT_CEILING constant

components.name: scripts/hooks/pre-tool-enforce.cjs
components.change: new ENF-18 enforcement block, thin wiring over the decision function

components.name: scripts/hooks/lib/handoff-execute-precheck-guard.cjs
components.change: NEW -- parseHandoffExecuteCall + evaluateHandoffExecutePrecheck, pure/injectable decision logic

implementation_approach.summary: Implement the KPI-0 reader split and the ENF-18 hook refusal reusing existing evidence-validation logic; escalate from the originating QF once the diff was found to touch the sensitive pre-tool-enforce.cjs path; correct the SD-identifier resolution bug a VALIDATION sub-agent pass found during LEAD review.
steps: Split deriveOutcomeFlow's rejected-handoff numerator into premature_attempts vs gate_retries; redefine rework_rate
Add ENF-18 to pre-tool-enforce.cjs, reusing validateSubagentEvidence with a WAIT exemption
Extract the command-parsing and decision logic into a side-effect-free lib module for direct unit testing
Escalate to a full SD when the QF completion pipeline's eligibility preflight refused autonomous completion (sensitive path)
VALIDATION sub-agent LEAD-phase review found ENF-18 passed the raw CLI token instead of a resolved SD row into validateSubagentEvidence, silently refusing real execute calls
Fix: resolve via resolveSdInputOrNull before the evidence call; also repairs the WAIT race-window (phase-start resolution needs the same row) and a fail-closed bug on infra-failure shapes
Re-verify live against this SD's own LEAD-TO-PLAN handoff after the fix

smoke_test_steps.instruction: From a repo with SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY set, pick an SD/handoff-type combo with no fresh sub-agent evidence for the current phase, then run: node scripts/handoff.js execute <TYPE> <SD-ID> as a Bash tool call
smoke_test_steps.expected_outcome: The Bash call is refused by the PreToolUse hook with an [ENF-18] PREMATURE EXECUTE REFUSED message and exit code 2 -- no rejected sd_phase_handoffs row is written for this attempt

smoke_test_steps.instruction: Invoke the required sub-agent(s) for that phase (writing a fresh sub_agent_execution_results row), then re-run the same handoff.js execute command
smoke_test_steps.expected_outcome: The Bash call proceeds normally (ENF-18 does not refuse it); the handoff runs its own gate pipeline as before

smoke_test_steps.instruction: Query lib/oversight/coordinator-health-sharpenings.mjs computeOutcomeFlow() for a 7-day window covering the SD above
smoke_test_steps.expected_outcome: The returned object carries premature_attempts, premature_attempt_rate, and gate_retries fields alongside rework_rate, and rework_rate does not include any ENF-18-refused attempt (since ENF-18 prevents the write) or a SUBAGENT_EVIDENCE_MISSING-tagged legacy row
